declarations.purpose: Runtime static mesh import from files or in-memory data, including FBX, OBJ, glTF/GLB, and Collada (DAE), using the bundled Assimp library.
declarations.why_required: The RuntimeAssetImport module uses Assimp to parse supported static 3D mesh formats at runtime in packaged Unreal Engine applications. The external assimp module supplies the Win64 import library and delay-loaded runtime DLL.
declarations.additional_information: Assimp 6.0.5 is built as a shared library from the official v6.0.5 source tag with the COLLADA, FBX, GLTF, and OBJ importers enabled. The plugin ships the assimp-vc143-mt.dll runtime, import library, headers, and assimp.tps notice; the repository build metadata records the unchanged upstream source tree.
